paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The plot titled “INSPIRED” illustrates how two evaluation metrics, Recall@50 and NDCG@50, vary with the depth of search, and includes constant reference levels for ReFICR. The x-axis is unlabeled and shows integer depth values on a linear scale from 1 to 5, with ticks at every integer. The left y-axis is labeled “Recall@50” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0.25 to 0.65 with labeled ticks at 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6. The right y-axis is labeled “NDCG@50” on a linear scale, ranging from 0.10 to 0.35 with labeled ticks at 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, and 0.35. There are four lines: (1) a green solid line with circular markers labeled “Recall@50 (Ours)” that increases across depth, from about 0.37 at depth 1 to about 0.56 at depth 5 (with intermediate points near 0.46 at depth 2, 0.50 at depth 3, and 0.54 at depth 4); (2) a green dotted horizontal line labeled “Recall@50 (ReFICR)” that stays flat at approximately 0.33 across all depths; (3) a blue solid line with square markers labeled “NDCG@50 (Ours)” that rises gradually from about 0.21 at depth 1 to about 0.26 at depth 5 (around 0.24 at depth 2, 0.245 at depth 3, and 0.25 at depth 4); and (4) a blue dotted horizontal line labeled “NDCG@50 (ReFICR)” that remains constant at approximately 0.11 for all depth values.
